prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a transparent GAME SPRITE ATLAS with EXACTLY 3 columns and 3 rows, 9 equal square cells. No visible grid. One full-body character centred inside EACH cell, all edges inside its cell, broad 15% transparent margins. Characters never cross cells. Match the reference image's polished hand-painted warm fantasy strategy-game style, natural linen/petrol/sage/wood palette, soft sunlight, clear silhouettes when small. All face LEFT. Original designs, not official Trimps artwork. Reading order from top-left across rows: spider with eight visible legs; armoured beetle; praying mantis; large butterfly; penguin; turtle with broad shell; coiled snake; tentacled squid; curled shrimp. All 9 characters distinct and equally sized within their cells. Actual transparent background. NO text, labels, numbers, watermarks, scenery, shadows on a ground plane or UI borders. A square atlas, perfect evenly spaced alignment matters for CSS sprites.
